notes: SearXNG "403 Forbidden" from local Docker instance: — the default SearXNG config has `searchdns: true`, which does a DNS-based client IP check. Connections from Docker bridge IPs (172.17.x.x) fail this check, returning 403. Updated all Docker commands in Help docs and Settings description to include `-e SEARXNG_DNS__SEARCH_DNS=false`. Added a dedicated "Why does SearXNG return 403 Forbidden?" Q&A in all 3 languages (EN/AR/ARZ) that explains the root cause and fix. | SearXNG 403 log message now suggests the fix: — when a SearXNG request returns 403, the "Blocked on SearXNG Discovery" log line now appends `| FIX: SearXNG needs searchdns=false. Add -e SEARXNG_DNS__SEARCH_DNS=false to your docker run command`, so the user sees the solution directly in the log.
